mapper.select: select a.bldg_id, a.bldg_nm from building a inner join tenancy b on (a.rental_pty_id = b.rental_pty_id) inner join member c on (b.mbr_cd = c.mbr_cd) where c.mbr_cd = #{mbrCd}
select USAGE_VALUE as 사용량 , UNIT_CHARGE_INFO as 청구금액 from MANAGEMENT_ENTITY_MONTHLY_CHARGE_AGGREGATION where dum_month = to_char(sysdate, 'yyyymm') and unit_id = #{unitId}

select a.unit_id, a.unit_room from unit a inner join unit_resident b on (a.unit_id = b.unit_id) inner join building c on (a.bldg_id = c.bldg_id and a.rental_pty_id = c.rental_pty_id) where c.bldg_id = #{bldgId} and c.rental_pty_id = #{rentalPtyId} and b.unit_del_yn ='N'
